name: Sweat Bee
desc: Sweat Bee (Lasioglossum leucozonium): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 14 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Lasioglossum leucozonium (Schrank, 1781), also known as Lasioglossum similis, is a widespread solitary sweat bee found in North America, Europe, Asia, and parts of northern Africa.
